cases.sql: CREATE TABLE wf (id integer, g integer, k integer, v integer)

SELECT id, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY k) AS s, count(*) OVER (ORDER BY k) AS n, count(v) OVER (ORDER BY k) AS nv, avg(v) OVER (ORDER BY k) AS a, min(v) OVER (ORDER BY k) AS lo, max(v) OVER (ORDER BY k) AS hi FROM wf ORDER BY id
SELECT id, sum(v) OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k) AS s, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k) AS n FROM wf ORDER BY id
SELECT id, sum(v) OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC) AS s, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC NULLS LAST) AS n FROM wf ORDER BY id

SELECT id, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY k, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rows_frame, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY k RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS range_frame, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY k GROUPS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS groups_frame FROM wf ORDER BY id
SELECT id, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY g, k) AS by_two_keys, count(*) OVER (ORDER BY g) AS by_group FROM wf ORDER BY id
SELECT id, sum(v) OVER w AS s, count(*) OVER w AS n FROM wf WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k) ORDER BY id
SELECT id, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY k RANGE UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS short_range, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY k, id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS short_rows FROM wf ORDER BY id
SELECT k, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY k) AS s FROM wf WHERE g = 2 ORDER BY id
SELECT id, sum(v) OVER () AS total, sum(v) OVER (PARTITION BY g) AS by_g, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY g) AS n, max(v) OVER (PARTITION BY g) AS hi FROM wf ORDER BY id

SELECT id, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY k RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS to_end, count(*) OVER (ORDER BY k RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW) AS peers, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY k GROUPS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW) AS peer_sum FROM wf ORDER BY id

SELECT id, first_value(v) OVER w AS f, last_value(v) OVER w AS l, nth_value(v, 2) OVER w AS n2, nth_value(v, 4) OVER w AS n4 FROM (SELECT * FROM wf ORDER BY k, id) s WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY k) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, last_value(v) OVER (w ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rows_last, last_value(v) OVER (w RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS range_last, last_value(v) OVER (w GROUPS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS groups_last FROM (SELECT * FROM wf ORDER BY k, id) s WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY k) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, first_value(v) OVER (w RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS range_first, first_value(v) OVER (w GROUPS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS next_group_first, last_value(v) OVER (w RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS whole_last FROM (SELECT * FROM wf ORDER BY k, id) s WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY k) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, first_value(v) OVER w AS f, last_value(v) OVER w AS l, nth_value(v, 2) OVER w AS n2, count(*) OVER w AS n FROM wf WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, first_value(v) OVER w AS f, sum(v) OVER w AS s, count(*) OVER w AS n, count(v) OVER w AS nv, max(v) OVER w AS hi FROM wf WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 FOLLOWING AND 3 FOLLOWING) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY k RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS near, count(*) OVER (ORDER BY k RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS back_one, count(*) OVER (ORDER BY k RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS ahead_one FROM wf ORDER BY id

SELECT id, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY k DESC RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS desc_back, count(*) OVER (ORDER BY k NULLS FIRST RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS nulls_first FROM wf ORDER BY id

SELECT id, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY k GROUPS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS near_groups, count(*) OVER (ORDER BY k GROUPS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS previous_group FROM wf ORDER BY id

SELECT id, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY k RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW) AS ex_current, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY k RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE GROUP) AS ex_group, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY k RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE TIES) AS ex_ties, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY k RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE NO OTHERS) AS ex_none FROM wf ORDER BY id
